method: Web search and page fetches on 2026-11-01. Evidence levels: fetched_full, search_excerpt, report_only.
conflicting_sources: Report says current mandi dataset is the API route; data.gov.in page says its API does not exist.
key_findings: Mandi: no working data.gov.in API/resource ID confirmed. Live mandi answers stay templates until one is tested.
IMD: free for non-commercial use only; written permission needed for production/commercial use. Endpoint details unverified.
Haryanvi: no Gnani confirmation found. Keep as accent testing only. Gnani Prisma/Timbre v3.0 now exist alongside the v2.5 in the project's stack.
The HAU sowing window is confirmed only from a search excerpt of an undated, possibly older package.
Only Himachal Pradesh wheat guidance was fully read from an official page. Haryana, Punjab, UP, Rajasthan and Uttarakhand have no fully verified crop packages yet.
The report's Meghalaya package values were excluded.
The report cites unrelated haryana.gov.in pages for data.gov.in and IMD claims; they were not used.
unverified_claims: claim-004: data.gov.in resource API route is api.data.gov.in/resource/<id> with api-key
claim-005: A working mandi resource ID exists
claim-009: IMD has a dedicated Agromet Advisory API
claim-010: Mausam SANKALP block-level parameters (rain, Tmax/Tmin, RH, wind)
claim-014: PM-KISAN family = husband, wife and minor children
claim-018: Wheat first irrigation ~35 days after sowing (ICAR-IISWC)
claim-019: Wheat variety suitability (HD 2967, DBW 187, HD 3226, HDCSW 18, UP lists)
missing_official_documents: Current HAU wheat package of practices (full PDF, dated)
PAU, UP (CSAUK/SVPUAT), Rajasthan (SKRAU/MPUAT), Uttarakhand (GBPUAT) crop packages
Haryana, Punjab, UP, Rajasthan, Uttarakhand state scheme notifications
CIB&RC registered pesticide uses and label claims
LGD district list for all seven regions

empty_files_and_reasons.fertilizers/*: Only a rejected Meghalaya package seen; no Northern India doses verified
empty_files_and_reasons.plant_protection/*: No registered-use, dose, stage and PHI evidence; chemical advice intentionally empty

limitations: Most 'verified' entries rest on search excerpts, not full documents.
No API call to data.gov.in or IMD was made (no keys).
Dates of many documents are unknown.
Hindi answers were written by Claude from verified facts and need native-speaker review.
